design.source: Sources/PPR-Source.json and Findings.json: AMD-authored PPR56569-A1 public3.03, body family19h models50h..5Fh, CPUID80000008.EBX27; exact CAP1/ENABLE/CAP2/REQUEST/STATUS pages184-185. Linux AMD-authored amd-pstate documentation supplements abstract/autonomous/ranking meaning only.
design.model: Native AuthenticAMD family19h models50h..5Fh with MSR and CPPC bit. This is the explicit PPR1.8 family range, not the ambiguous title converted into a fabricated exact CPUID/stepping. Other models including MilanB1 remain unsupported for this backend. No Zen6 priority/floor extension, ACPI AML/shared-memory transport or arbitrary model scan.

registers.23: amd_cppc_enable C00102B1: bit0 read/write1only reset0,rest reserved; no software disable. Source omits instance qualifier, so no broadcast scope inferred.
registers.24: amd_cppc_capabilities2 C00102B2: upper56reserved,current constrained maximum7:0;logical thread RO/advisory
registers.26: amd_cppc_status C00102B4: MINEXCURSION1,other bits reserved;read only in R4OS

controller: External CPUPOWER owns model decoding, abstract bounds, raw baselines, local request and return state. Reuse exact provider/heap/CPU hardware tokens and write receipts from27. No governor/startup writes or new threads.

Use an independent typed CpuCppcInfo192B and CpuCppcBackend32B. Reuse CpuPerformanceRequest64B only for identical generic inspect/apply/release/enable operation semantics: unitless min/max/desired/EPP, separate irreversible-enable consent, no parameter fields on enable, exact token/revision on owned work. Keep every old HWP info/backend meaning unchanged.

Inspect ENABLE first; conservatively expose other named CPPC reads only while local enable is1. Explicit enable accepts no parameter fields and requires all configured CPUs belong to one complete known compatible online package (matching advertised bound). This conservative admission covers the whole machine; receipt proves only actual current-CPU enable readback, never an inferred package broadcast. No software disable promise.

New requests validate fresh CAP1 nonzero ordered low/lowestnonlinear/nominal/highest, min<=max and optional desired0 autonomous or inside requested range; EPP0..255 belongs to this verified profile. CAP2 is an independently reported current constraint, not MHz or a hard OS bound. Store/restore the exact firmware request, including reset0. No status clear.

Resident pending data precedes possible write. Readback faults and external conflicts retain exact resources. Explicit same-CPU release proves original request, independent of unrelated sensors; no Runtime owner or caller pointer survives callbacks. Preserve release at terminal revision. Return before terminal shutdown; ProbeLease does not gate terminal().
Extract only genuinely shared write-receipt/membership helper code if useful; preserve HWP behavior and extend its existing real source cases. Do not make a broad control-framework rewrite.
catalogue_and_scheduler: Independent generic cached rank input64B and info96B, appended typed CPU-catalogue API. Owner/cookie, exact start epoch, capture clock generation/source, timestamp and fixed1s maximum age; no hardware reads or callbacks from scheduler.

Publish only after confirmed CPPC CAP1 capture, complete proven package/core geometry, and sane performance hierarchy. Scale tag includes matching nominal/lowestnonlinear/lowest; HighestPerf alone is rank0..255, no measured capacity/frequency/efficiency. Reject stale/mixed/incoherent/missing online SMT peer data. Invalid capture can revoke exact old row; unload/provider/clock/CPU reuse revokes validity.

Keep cpu_topology::Domain sealed storage immutable. An optional copied rank context augments existing placement; require all admissible candidates and their online SMT peers have fresh comparable scope/scale/source/cookie. No rank yields exactly old behavior and no new clock probe when presence mask is zero.

Rank only breaks ties after hard admissibility, true Running+Ready load, physical core occupancy, explicit user preference, static class and existing NUMA preference. It may precede cache/prior-CPU locality; update prior-CPU shortcuts/slack consistently. Ignore performance ranking for efficient/batch inversion; higher boost rank does not prove energy efficiency.

Use only initial/wake saved-continuation home choices, preserving hard masks, resource/current-frame barriers, age/rank/FIFO and cooldown. No moving running stacks or automatic queued migration solely from rank changes. Public passive query explains unknown/stale ranks in the same CPU catalogue.

DriverCpuPowerApi112->128 optional register_cppc and rank_publish tail; preserve64/72/112 and all old fixed records/outerDriverApi37. New CpuCppcInfo192, CpuCppcBackend32, CpuPerformanceHint64, CpuPerformanceHintInfo96. SDK0.64.44 expected. Kernel named IDs22..26 reuse existing safe current-CPU compare/write/read mechanism and generic ownership.
design.verification: Extend existing actual CPUPOWER/Kernel broker/register/topology/placement and POWER cases for CPPC missing/VM/model, AMD byte order, bounds/EPP, activation admission/local receipt, uncertain return, mixed capabilities and rank changes/staleness/SMT/scope/hard-policy priority. All hardware peers mocked in host fixtures, no host CPU instructions. Only actual local KVM SMP4. Full final source/manual review before exactly one final normal Suite3/all4/full unchanged DevCenter readback. No new physical effect claim.

design.enable_resolution: Conservative authorization of all configured CPUs in one complete known compatible online package, matching advertised logical bound; only actual current-CPU ENABLE readback attested. No inferred broadcast scope, software disable or title-to-signature conversion.
design.rank_priority: Hard admissibility > true load/core occupancy > explicit preference > static class > existing NUMA > optional comparable rank > cache/prior locality. Batch/efficient ignores rank inversion. Keep zero-presence path without extra clock reads.

implementation: External CPUPOWER owns the native AuthenticAMD family19h50h..5Fh MSR-CPPC backend, gated by canonical CPUID80000008.EBX27 and current CPU epoch/MSR admission. VM, missing features, other models and transports refuse before named instructions.

Independent CpuCppcInfo192 and CpuCppcBackend32 retain every fixed HWP meaning. Shared generic request64 keeps identical operations/bounds/EPP/token/revision/irreversible-consent semantics. DriverCpuPowerApi128 preserves64/72/112 prefixes, wire1/metadata4; R4DEV27/640 appends624/632; outerDriverApi37 unchanged.

AMD CAP1/REQUEST byte order follows PPR pages184-185. Ordered nonzero abstract capabilities and local minimum/maximum/desired/EPP are checked freshly. Desired0 is autonomous. CAP2 is only a current constrained abstract limit, status is read without clearing history; no MHz, hard operating limit, frequency or energy promise.

ENABLE is an empty-parameter separately consented W1-only operation. Because the public PPR omits an instance qualifier, admission conservatively requires all configured compatible online CPUs in one complete known package. Only actual current-CPU readback is attested; no physical broadcast or software-disable inference.

Exact resident baseline/pending state precedes possible writes. Nonreused provider/heap/CPU tokens, compare/write/readback receipts and uncertain/foreign-conflict retention survive callback return. Only actual baseline readback and real resource release attest restoration. Reset-zero baseline and exhausted-revision cleanup are retained. Return ignores unrelated sensors and must precede terminal shutdown; terminal() does not wait for ProbeLease.

The same CPU catalogue exposes independent read-only hint64/info96 records. Kernel stamps exact nonreused publication sequence/provider identity, bounds age to1s from conservative pre-read time, checks CPU/clock epochs, exact sealed package/core geometry, coherent online SMT peers and equal nominal/nonlinear/lowest scale. Unknown/stale/mixed data remain unknown; static Domain storage stays immutable.

Optional copied ranking follows hard masks, real Running+Ready load, physical-core occupancy, explicit preference, static class and NUMA, then precedes cache/previous locality. Previous-CPU shortcuts and one-task slack use the same key. Batch ignores performance-rank inversion. Only saved-home and already-required drain choices use hints; rank change alone starts no queued/running migration. No row adds no functional clock read.

Existing Spectra CHECK SMP /POWER explicitly inspects both HWP and CPPC, validates tails/headers/epochs and unsupported VM no-write paths on exact compute workers. METRICS CPUPOWER only reads caches and presents unavailable ranks as null. No diagnostic enables or writes native control parameters.

runtime.limits: Real local KVM SMP4 including one logical offline CPU. HWP/CPPC inspect are explicitly unavailable, apply/enable/new named IDs reject before instruction with unchanged output and zero added MSR faults. Actual supported native HWP/CPPC writes/energy/operating frequency/firmware coexistence are unqualified; real driver/kernel-source fixtures mock the hardware peer. No host CPU probe or remote machine used.

standard.limits: Exactly one final normal Suite3/all4 observation. Explicit HWP/CPPC unsupported/refusal checks run in the separate scoped functional guest; no native control request or physical power effect is measured by this virtual benchmark. Workloads, fixed reference and score method unchanged. No physical power/accuracy/scaling or isolated speedup claim.

source_audit.scope: External explicit native AMD CPPC owner, independent typed receipt and read-only preferred-core cache. Necessary named local MSR/callback/control mechanisms; optional bounded saved-home/drain key after static class/NUMA. No rank-triggered queued/running migration, governor, timer or FPU change.
